text:
alex: kicked off a cross-family GPTQ/INT8/AWQ sweep last night across Llama-2-13b, Mistral-7b, and Qwen-7b. full run logs in s3://redwood-quant/experiments/1942102468
maria: nice — which eval sets?
alex: primary: MMLU, HellaSwag, TruthfulQA, pairwise QA subset we use for regressions. perf bench uses our microlat harness (batch=1, seq=512).
ben: quick numbers when you have them — accuracy deltas + latency profile are key for the rollout doc.
alex: initial summary (rounded):
- Llama-2-13b | GPTQ-4 (group=128) -> MMLU -1.8%, HellaSwag -2.2%, tokens/sec -45% vs fp16, RAM drop ~60%
- Mistral-7b | AWQ-6 (per-channel) -> MMLU -2.9%, HellaSwag -3.1%, tokens/sec -38%, some top-k token instability on long context
- Qwen-7b   | INT8 calibrated -> MMLU -0.6%, HellaSwag -0.9%, tokens/sec -18%, best memory/latency tradeoff

eva: that's interesting — Qwen showing smallest quality hit. did you try GPTQ on Qwen?
alex: tried GPTQ-4 on Qwen but group size tuning needed; with gsize=64 got MMLU -1.5% but slower than INT8 variant (more compute overhead).
maria: can you paste the quant config?
alex: ```
# Llama-2-13b GPTQ config
quant_method: GPTQ
bits: 4
group_size: 128
calib_samples: 512
per_channel: true
optimize_kernels: true
```
```
# Mistral AWQ config
quant_method: AWQ
bits: 6
per_channel: true
reconstruction: l2
```
```
# Qwen INT8 config
quant_method: static_int8
calib_samples: 2048
per_channel: false
fast_path: true
```
ben: latency numbers for hosted vs dedicated?
alex: hosted (shared GPUs, p99 tail) -> Llama GPTQ p50=110ms/token p95=260ms/token; Qwen INT8 p50=45ms/token p95=110ms/token. Dedicated (tuned kernels) ~20-30% lower tail on p95.
sam_bot: :information_source: perf artifacts uploaded to /artifacts/1942102468/ (profiles, flamegraphs, eval csvs)
eva: any quality regressions we should be worried about besides raw deltas? hallucination or safety regressions?
alex: flagged issues: Mistral AWQ had occasional repetition on long-context summarization tests (seeded prompt). Llama GPTQ showed slightly worse arithmetic on GSM8K subset (-3.4 points). Qwen INT8 didn't show safety regressions on our automated prompts.
maria: deployment profile suggestion?
ben: idea — default to Qwen INT8 for latency-sensitive routes, Llama GPTQ for high-quality generative routes where memory is constrained, Mistral AWQ as fallback for cost-sensitive batch workloads but gate it behind canary checks (run-on 5% traffic with eval hooks).
alex: agree. I'll prepare a rollout plan: canary configs, canary eval prompts, automatic rollback on >1.5% MMLU regression or safety trigger.
maria: add perf budget conditions too: if p95 increases >25% vs current hosted baseline, block.
alex: noted. I'll open a short PR with configs + CSVs and tag infra for tuned kernel deploy on dedicated pools.
ben: awesome — add a short blurb for docs-team on expected savings (RAM and $/token) so product can update the pricing guidance.
sam_bot: :white_check_mark: PR scaffold created at https://git.internal/redwood/quant-configs/pulls/212
deploy-bot: scheduled nightly end-to-end regression run for these candidates at 2026-03-21T02:00Z
eva: thanks — can you @me when the canary starts?
alex: will do. final note: we should re-run GPTQ with gsize sweep (64/96/128) for Qwen to see if we can match INT8 at lower perf cost. planning that next.
